tracks.title: Cái Võng Ban Công
tracks.mood: bickering, playful, deadpan funny, fond underneath
tracks.subject: a young couple in a Sài Gòn chung cư spending a Sunday arguing over how to hang a new hammock on their two-metre balcony — her between the window grille and the air-con pipe, him diagonally to the clothes rack — until it holds only when they both lie in it
